releaseTitle: ATalk v3.17.2 — Clean Query Alignment & Core Architecture Stability Release
releaseNotes:
• 01 Clean Query & Database Alignment: Synchronized client message fetch routines and database functions with the clean, hardened security baseline.
• 02 Core Architecture Stability: Reverted experimental keyboard/map overlays and unified the chat viewport on the proven, stable rendering engine.
• 03 Full Security Hardening Retained: Maintained PBKDF2 salted PIN hashing with exponential backoff lockout, network security config blocking cleartext traffic, and isolated security credentials table.
• 04 OTA Update Seamless Compatibility: Built with versionCode 84 to ensure automatic, zero-error in-app updates for all existing installations.
